# Sector — February 2002 announcement

- Original source: [Robin hood ohlásený](https://www.sector.sk/novinka/10742/robin-hood-ohlaseny.htm)
- Author / publication: saver; Sector.sk.
- Language / date: Slovak; 2002-02-04.
- Access: Full news item retrieved directly
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Retrieved: 2026-09-09
- Archived copy: lookup failed (archive.org rate limit); not checked
- Format: header notes, original summary, then complete factual notes (commercial news item, not transcribed)

An early announcement positions the forthcoming game as a tactical strategy from the makers of Desperados, set around Sherwood Forest. It advertises forty missions and names several familiar heroes and Guy of Gisborne.

This is a dated record of the project’s early publicity. The mission count is a prerelease claim, not a verified count of unique maps or mandatory campaign stages. The item provides neither a detailed production history nor evidence of the final release schedule.

## Detailed notes

Page facts: title "Robin hood ohlásený" (Robin Hood announced); posted by saver on 4.2.2002 at 23:17 under "hry" news; retrieved directly from sector.sk. A single-sentence news item; no comments shown. Slovak commercial news, not transcribed.

- Addressed to fans of Commandos and Desperados (both linked to Sector's own reviews): a new tactical strategy game, Robin Hood, is coming.
- It will be from the creators of Desperados and set in the Middle Ages, specifically the area of Sherwood Forest.
- Claim: the player will go through 40 tactical missions.
- Characters named: Robin Hood, Little John ("Málý John"), Marian, Friar Tuck ("Bratom Tucom"); among the enemies "the feared Guy of Gisbourne" (rendered "Guy s Gisbrounu").
- No publisher, price, platform or release date is given.
- Sidebar lists the same six related Sector news items as the other Sector pages (17.2.2003 CZ look; 3.2.2003 Gamestar discount; 6.11.2002 more screenshots; 28.10.2002 completed; 16.10.2002 CDprojekt; 16.10.2002 screenshots and video), not retrieved.
